articles.title: Sensex Rallies 427 Points to 82,532 as Bank Stocks Power Second Straight Gain
articles.excerpt: The Nifty closed at 25,387, its highest in nine months, as the Nifty Bank index hit a record 62,442 and foreign investors kept buying despite a weak global trend.
articles.nri_angle: Indian benchmarks rose for a second day on foreign inflows even as US and Asian markets fell, and the rupee strengthened to 93.47 per dollar — the backdrop for NRI portfolio and remittance decisions this week.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Yes Bank and RBI Ask Supreme Court to Review Verdict Restoring Rs 8,415 Crore of AT1 Bonds
articles.excerpt: Both the bank and the regulator filed review petitions on November 13 against the October 15 judgment that quashed the 2020 AT1 write-down, while bondholders pursue contempt proceedings to force restoration.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors were among the retail and institutional holders of Indian bank AT1 bonds, whose loss-absorption terms this case is defining.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Dow Falls 739 Points as Nvidia-Led AI Sell-Off Deepens Before Earnings
articles.excerpt: The Nasdaq lost 2.5% and the S&P 500 1.9% on Monday as Nvidia fell for a third straight day after Jensen Huang's resignation, and a new chip-export rule tightened the pressure on AI stocks.
articles.image_caption: Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California (file photo)
articles.nri_angle: AI and chip stocks are core holdings in many Indian-American retirement and brokerage portfolios, and Nvidia's earnings on Tuesday will set the tone for the sector those portfolios track.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Indian IT Firms Hold Cash Collection Steady as Clients Slow New Deals
articles.excerpt: Average days sales outstanding improved marginally to about 75 days, even as cautious client spending lengthens the road from deal approval to revenue.
articles.nri_angle: Many diaspora portfolios and jobs sit inside these firms; stable collections mean the sector's strain is showing up in new-deal timing, not in unpaid bills.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Jefferies Keeps Buy Ratings on Six Adani Stocks, Backs $51 Billion Capex Plan
articles.excerpt: The brokerage reaffirmed Buys across the Adani Group, set target prices for all six names, and projected 23% compound EBITDA and EPS growth through FY29 — while flagging leverage and execution risk.
articles.image_caption: The Adani logo on a group office building.
articles.nri_angle: Adani names are widely held in NRI portfolios; Jefferies' targets and its own leverage warnings frame both sides of the position.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Pump $7.5 Billion Into Indian Equities in Ten Sessions
articles.excerpt: The November inflow is the highest monthly figure in five years on Bloomberg data, reversing a year of heavy FPI selling — while domestic institutions book profits into a near-10% rally.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai. Foreign portfolio investors bought Indian equities at a five-year-high pace in early November.
articles.nri_angle: Foreign flows into Indian equities move the Sensex, the Nifty and the rupee — the benchmarks diaspora investors track for their India portfolios and remittance timing.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Chris Wood: India Wins the 'Reverse AI Trade', Energy Hedges the Iran Risk
articles.excerpt: In his latest GREED & fear note, Jefferies' Chris Wood argues the AI spending cycle has peaked and foreign money is rotating into India - while fresh US-Iran tensions are the biggest risk to the trade.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors, Wood's rotation call puts India - out of favour for two years - back at the centre of emerging-market portfolios, with oil-driven geopolitics as the named risk.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Sees India Growing 7.2% in 2027, Well Ahead of China's 4.5%
articles.excerpt: Goldman Sachs Research forecasts global growth of 2.8% in 2027 on rising AI investment and easing oil prices, with India's 7.2% forecast above the 6.8% consensus — and risks tilted to the downside.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors weighing India exposure, Goldman's 7.2% India forecast for 2027 sits above consensus, but the bank flags the same AI and energy drivers as its main downside risks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Pump ₹84,290 Crore Into Indian Stocks in November's First Fortnight
articles.excerpt: After pulling ₹70,704 crore out in September and October, FPIs returned in nine straight sessions as AI stocks sold off globally, crude fell 13% and large-caps looked cheap — but strategists call the turn tactical, not structural.
articles.image_caption: A pedestrian walks past a large rupee symbol installation. Foreign portfolio investors put a net Rs 84,290 crore into Indian equities in the first fortnight of November, reversing two months of outflows.
articles.nri_angle: For NRI investors, the ₹84,290 crore fortnight is a sentiment turn worth noting but not chasing: strategists describe tactical, index-heavy buying that has recovered only a fraction of 2026's ₹2.1 lakh crore net outflow.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India-Egypt Trade at $6.5 Billion Is 'Just a Beginning,' Goyal Says in Cairo
articles.excerpt: On a visit with a 132-member business delegation, the commerce minister pitched two-way trade and investment — and asked the Indian community in Egypt to write a modern 'Periplus' business guide for the route.
articles.image_caption: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal speaks at an event. Goyal is visiting Egypt with a 132-member business delegation, pitching a much larger two-way trade and investment partnership.
articles.nri_angle: For Indian exporters and the Indian business community in Egypt, Goyal's Cairo pitch names the sectors to watch — textiles, autos, pharma, ports and logistics — and a rupee settlement channel already live via SBI and Banque Misr.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tamil Nadu Investment Panel Sets $72 Billion Export Target at First Meeting
articles.excerpt: The Tamil Nadu Investment Promotion Commission, chaired by Chief Secretary Sai Kumar, reviewed 112 MoUs worth ₹1.14 lakh crore and fast-tracked work on a New Industrial Policy for 2027.
articles.image_caption: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, hands folded in greeting beside his official vehicle. The Investment Promotion Commission formed by his government held its first meeting on Friday and set a target of raising state exports to $72 billion.
articles.nri_angle: Tamil Nadu is one of India's largest exporter states and a major source of the global Tamil diaspora; its investment and jobs push shapes opportunities for families and businesses with roots in the state.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Carney Says Canada and US Making Progress Toward Trade Deal, No Agreement Yet
articles.excerpt: Speaking in Manila, Carney described a long call with President Trump and said a bilateral deal is possible — but Ottawa will not accept terms inconsistent with a viable Canadian auto sector.
articles.image_caption: The flag of Canada. Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada and the United States are making progress toward a trade deal, with no agreement yet reached.

articles.nri_angle: Canada-U.S. tariff terms affect North American auto and metals supply chains that employ many Indian-origin workers and businesses on both sides of the border.

articles.title: A2B Sells Majority Stake to James Murdoch-Backed Bodhi Tree in $180 Million Deal
articles.excerpt: The Chennai vegetarian chain, valued at about $350 million, will use the investment to expand in western India and Europe and modernise its kitchens. Uday Shankar will chair the new board.
articles.image_caption: Adyar Ananda Bhavan (A2B), the South Indian restaurant chain that sold a majority stake to Bodhi Tree Systems
articles.nri_angle: A2B already runs more than 30 outlets overseas, including in the US; the Europe expansion plan puts a familiar South Indian brand in more diaspora neighbourhoods.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sachin Tendulkar Invests in Recykal, Extending $23 Million Bridge Round
articles.excerpt: Tendulkar joins the Hyderabad waste-management platform as a strategic investor for an undisclosed amount; Recykal has raised over $60 million and reported ₹1,498 crore FY26 gross revenue.
articles.nri_angle: An Indian cleantech investment by a diaspora-recognised sporting figure, in a private company with no listed-market action.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Tata's JLR Targets Double-Digit Earnings Growth in Fiscal 2028 After Guidance Cut
articles.excerpt: Reuters reports the fiscal 2028 target rests on £1.7 billion of cost cuts and new electric models — separate from the reported September-quarter loss of £451 million and a fiscal 2027 margin outlook cut to 2% to 3%.
articles.nri_angle: JLR is the earnings engine of India's Tata Motors, so its guidance cut and fiscal 2028 recovery target bear directly on one of India's most widely held automotive stocks.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Diwali Rally Faces Test Beyond Festive Sentiment, Analysts Say
articles.excerpt: A Mint analysis of Bloomberg data shows the Sensex's 8.78% pre-Muhurat surge was the biggest in three decades, but in 6 of 19 comparable years the gains did not last — and analysts say foreign cash buying, crude and Q2 earnings will decide this one.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora holders of Indian equities, the sourced test is flows and Q2 earnings over the next few weeks, not the Diwali pattern alone.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Stock Futures Edge Lower After Slide As Nvidia Turmoil Weighs On AI Trade
articles.excerpt: Nasdaq futures led early declines on Friday after Nvidia fell 4.3% on Jensen Huang's exit, with oil above $95 and producer price data next.
articles.nri_angle: US-listed AI stocks are a core holding for many diaspora portfolios, so Nvidia's leadership change and the Fed pricing around it affect those investors directly.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Ends 319 Points Lower, Nifty At 25,144 As Inflation Breaches RBI Limit
articles.excerpt: Benchmarks snapped a three-day winning run on November 13 as October inflation at 6.09% and crude above $95 a barrel weighed on auto, realty and metal stocks.
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors tracking Indian portfolios saw a weekly gain trimmed, not reversed, with the inflation print now the key input for the RBI's next decision.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bank of Baroda Hikes 555-Day FD Rate to 6.85 Percent: What Rs 1 Lakh Earns
articles.excerpt: The bob Golden Goal 555-day deposit now pays 6.85% to general customers and up to 7.50% to super senior citizens, effective November 12 — the only tenor the bank changed.
articles.nri_angle: The 555-day scheme includes NRE and NRO deposits below Rs 3 crore at the general-customer rate, so NRI depositors get the same 6.85%.

articles.title: Amul Raises Milk Prices by Up to Rs 4 a Litre, Second Hike in Six Months
articles.excerpt: GCMMF cites fodder, feed, packaging and fuel costs plus uneven rainfall for the November 12 increase. Taaza rises ₹2 a litre, Gold ₹4, and Mother Dairy has moved in step.
articles.image_caption: The Amul dairy plant at Anand, Gujarat. GCMMF raised fresh pouch milk prices by Rs 2-4 per litre from November 12, its second increase in six months.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora households supporting family in India, a second milk price hike in six months is a direct, recurring addition to monthly support budgets.

articles.title: Mercor's Indian-Origin Founders Double Wealth to $4.2 Billion Each at 23
articles.excerpt: A $750 million funding round valuing AI hiring startup Mercor at $20 billion has lifted Forbes' estimates for co-founders Adarsh Hiremath and Surya Midha, and CEO Brendan Foody, to about $4.2 billion each.
articles.nri_angle: Hiremath and Midha, Indian-American school friends from San Jose, are now among the world's richest self-made founders in their early twenties — paper wealth tied to a private valuation, not cash.

articles.title: Vodafone Idea Q2 Loss Widens After One-Off Charge, ARPU Rises
articles.excerpt: For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, Vodafone Idea's reported net loss widened to Rs 5,975 crore after a Rs 462 crore exceptional charge, even as its pre-exceptional loss narrowed and ARPU rose to Rs 198.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors tracking Indian telecom holdings get the reported-versus-expected distinction and the one-off charge behind the wider headline loss.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Brazil's WEG Picks Dharmapuri for Rs 2,000 Crore Manufacturing Facility
articles.excerpt: The Brazilian electrical equipment maker confirmed Tamil Nadu after a five-month negotiation, with a proposed Rs 2,000-crore investment and potential for around 3,000 jobs, the Industries Department said.
articles.nri_angle: Straight business and investment coverage with no forced diaspora framing, as briefed.

articles.title: NPCI's MDR-Funded Scheme Pays Banks to Put UPI QR Codes in Small-Town Shops
articles.excerpt: The UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme recycles 5% of future MDR collections into Rs 300-per-QR and Rs 750-per-soundbox incentives for banks onboarding small merchants in Tier III-VI cities, the Northeast, J&K and Ladakh.
articles.image_caption: A hand holds a phone displaying a UPI QR code, surrounded by Indian payment app logos. NPCI's UPI Vyapaar Saksham Scheme pays banks to deploy QR codes and soundboxes at small merchants.
articles.nri_angle: Merchant-side change only: UPI payments up to Rs 2,000 and P2P transfers stay outside MDR, so NRI visitors paying by UPI in India face no new charge.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Companies Led by Indian-Origin Chiefs Now Worth $15 Trillion, Up 53%, Hurun Finds
articles.excerpt: The second HSBC Hurun Global Indians List counts 236 Indian-origin CEOs, chairpersons, and founders across 200 companies headquartered outside India, with more than 70% of the value in AI-driven firms.
articles.nri_angle: The Hurun list quantifies the diaspora's corporate footprint: 236 Indian-origin leaders running companies worth a combined $15 trillion outside India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Retail Inflation Breaches RBI Ceiling at 6.09% as Food Prices Surge
articles.excerpt: October's CPI reading, the highest since October 2024, crossed the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit as food inflation hit 8.94% and onion prices more than doubled, strengthening expectations of a second straight rate hike in December.
articles.image_caption: A trader sorts onions at a wholesale market, with sacks of onions stacked behind him. Onion prices rose 116.22% year on year in October, driving India's food inflation to 8.94%.
articles.nri_angle: Inflation above the RBI ceiling and a possible December rate hike affect rupee returns on NRE deposits and the cost of supporting family budgets in India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Bajaj Finance Launches Rs 11,700 Crore QIP at Rs 992.25 Floor Price
articles.excerpt: The institutional share sale is half of a Rs 17,500 crore capital plan, alongside Rs 5,800 crore of warrants allotted to promoter Bajaj Finserv at Rs 1,010 each.
articles.nri_angle: Bajaj Finance is a widely held Indian financial stock among diaspora investors; the QIP pricing will signal institutional appetite for Indian consumer credit.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Nvidia Slides 8% on Report Board May Oust Huang; Sensex Ends 117 Points Lower
articles.excerpt: The after-hours fall followed a Journal report on CEO Jensen Huang; Nvidia's board said on November 8 it had no reason to believe company secrets were compromised.
articles.nri_angle: Nvidia is a core holding in diaspora portfolios and Indian chip-linked stocks track the global AI trade; the board has not announced a decision.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: CoreWeave Revenue Jumps 168% as Results Revive AI Trade and Lift Nasdaq
articles.excerpt: The AI cloud company's $3.66 billion quarter beat expectations, its backlog reached $132.5 billion, and its shares rose 24.7% — even as its net loss widened to $709 million.
articles.nri_angle: AI infrastructure shares are a large holding for many diaspora investors; Nvidia's November 17 results are the next check on the rally.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Goldman Sachs Adds a March Rate Hike to Its Federal Reserve Forecast
articles.excerpt: Goldman Sachs now expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates by 25 basis points in March, abandoning its call that the hiking cycle would end in December, after October inflation came in hotter than expected for a third straight month, Reuters reported.
articles.nri_angle: Goldman's higher-for-longer path affects diaspora households directly through US mortgage and borrowing costs, with no cut in its forecast until December 2027.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Sensex Surges Over 1,200 Points Intraday As Crude Falls, FIIs Buy
articles.excerpt: Live snapshots on November 11 put the Sensex up 1,280 points at 9:53 a.m. before trimming gains by afternoon, with Kalyan Jewellers rallying over 12% on results and RVNL also higher intraday.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora investors in Indian equities saw a broad post-Diwali intraday rally driven by FII buying, cheaper crude and a stronger rupee, with levels stated as live snapshots.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Adani Group Unveils $120 Billion Capex Plan Over Five Years
articles.excerpt: Executives told Fortune India the group plans more than $20 billion a year across energy, transport and adjacencies — a group-wide five-year plan distinct from Adani Enterprises' annual guidance last week.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora investors holding Adani listed companies, this is a group-wide five-year spending plan to track against filings and results, distinct from the flagship's annual guidance.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Gold Falls Sharply in Dollars, but Indian Gold ETFs Still Hold Gains Since Last Diwali
articles.excerpt: Spot gold is down 28.8% from its January peak in dollar terms, yet a weaker rupee and higher import duty cushioned the rupee fall, and Indian gold ETFs averaged 9.22% since Diwali 2025.
articles.nri_angle: Explains why a 28.8% dollar gold fall translated into a smaller rupee loss and still-positive ETF returns since last Diwali for Indian and diaspora holders of Indian gold ETFs.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
